subject: new method for comparing modular signal

messages.author: 7deb3bfa9709c09a
messages.subject: new method for comparing modular signal
parts:
Fellow morphometricians,

I am pleased to announce that we have a new method, based on multivariate effect sizes, for comparing the strength of modular signal across datasets, and among alternative modular hypotheses for the same dataset. The method is implemented in the latest version of geomorph, and description of the approach may be found in Evolution:

https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/evo.13867 

Best, 

Dean and the geomorph team 

--

Dean Adams
